privileged_info_for_vlm: The LP165P model at 20x20 degree/order is mandatory. For Sat_Circular, the expected lifetime is approximately 16 days (must be < 59 days) and minimum altitude should be near 0 or negative (crash). For Sat_Frozen, the propagation must last 60 days; the minimum altitude is expected to be significantly lower than the starting altitude due to mascons, potentially reaching negative values (approx -61 km) if the simulation doesn't stop on contact.
